requirements.rationale: SessionsService and SessionAccessGuard correctly enforce authenticated session membership and active joined participant lookup, returning 401 when unauthenticated, 403 when session is mismatched, and 404 when participant is not joined.
viewLiveStream does not verify session.status <> SessionStatus::ENDED; when invoked on an ENDED session, it returns HTTP 200 with ENDED stream status instead of rejecting the call.
viewLiveStream returns data containing exact sessionId, participantId, and viewerRole matching the session and joined participant.
viewLiveStream returns exact streamStatus, streamVersion, and sessionVersion matching the current live stream and session entities.
canPlayMedia is absent from the view representation and playback controls in the client UI remain enabled when stream.status is ENDED.
canPublishMedia is absent from the view representation and microphone/camera publishing controls remain enabled in the client UI for a VIEWER on an ENDED stream.
initialAudioMuted is absent from the view representation and the client UI initializes audio volume at 75 rather than muted.

defects.trigger: Viewer calls viewLiveStream on a live session whose status is ENDED
defects.description: SessionsService.viewLiveStream fails to check that session.status <> SessionStatus::ENDED as required by BR-WLS-02, returning HTTP 200 with ended stream status instead of rejecting the request.

defects.trigger: Viewer opens live-stream viewer interface for a non-live or ended stream without STAGE_PARTICIPANT role
defects.description: LiveStreamViewer and SessionsService do not enforce stream playback availability (canPlayMedia only when LIVE), publishing availability (canPublishMedia only when LIVE and STAGE_PARTICIPANT), or initial muted audio (initialAudioMuted), leaving play and mic/camera controls unconditionally enabled and unmuted at volume 75.
